record.question: Who is the Chief Minister of Jharkhand?
record.explanation: Answer B: Shibu Soren. The Lok Sabha Secretariat’s historical Jharkhand table records the Shibu Soren coalition that lost majority in May 2010 before President’s Rule on 1 June. This is the Shibu Soren administration existing at the 24 March 2010 exam. Historical/source note: Historical Chief Minister, not a present officeholder. Reference: https://eparlib.sansad.in/bitstream/123456789/761237/1/Presidents_Rule_in_St_UT_Eng_9th_ed_2016.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
